plain: Nice work decoding this warmup! To solve, submit this exact answer to the Game Master: jade-quarry-58
encoded: BGNTH SZRGW SNFKG PWEDB HTLPX LHCON MUWNY SQFEZ WEDBN ETBWT BOHAZ CCHEA IEPHQ HCWTP QBGWL YTQQZ
generator_cmd: PYTHONPATH=tools/pyciphers python3 -c "import secretpy as S; S.Playfair().encrypt(LETTERS, KEY)".upper() then 5-letter groups joined by spaces
oracle_cmd: PYTHONPATH=tools/pyciphers python3 -c "import pycipher as P; print(P.Playfair(SQUARE(KEY)).decipher(encoded).lower())"  # SQUARE = keyword letters (J->I) deduped + rest of A-Z sans J; raw output keeps the X fillers
